vo.text: Jake and Maya are cousins, and today is a very big day.

vo.text: Their class is going on a field trip to the bank!

vo.text: Grandma gives them each a shiny ten-dollar gift card. “This is your lunch money — the rest is yours to choose.”
vo.tts: [warmly] Grandma gives them each a shiny ten-dollar gift card. “This is your lunch money — the rest is yours to choose.”

vo.text: The school bus rolls into Fairweather, the city of money.
vo.tts: [curiously] The school bus rolls into Fairweather, the city of money.

vo.text: Inside, the bank sparkles like a museum of gold and glass.

vo.text: A kind banker with a gray beard waves hello — the Iron Banker! He wears deep purple and gold armor — like the most important suit in the world.

vo.text: On the way to the tour, they pass a shop full of toys and candy.

vo.text: The Iron Banker shows them a giant vault stacked with coins.
vo.tts: [in awe] The Iron Banker shows them a giant vault stacked with coins.

vo.text: Soon their tummies rumble — it's time for lunch!
vo.tts: [playfully] Soon their tummies rumble — it's time for lunch!

vo.text: At the food counter, a sandwich costs more than Jake expected. Maya counts her money again and again, but the numbers won't come out right.

vo.text: Then something crackles strangely beside the candy rack. It's The Swipe — a shimmer that makes things look too good to pass up!

vo.text: And hiding behind the high food prices stands Jack the Ruiner.
vo.tts: [ominously] And hiding behind the high food prices stands Jack the Ruiner.

vo.text: “You can see them now,” the Iron Banker says gently. “Most grown-ups can see them too, once they know to look.”
vo.tts: [gently] “You can see them now,” the Iron Banker says gently. “Most grown-ups can see them too, once they know to look.”

vo.text: “The Swipe makes you want things fast, and Jack hides sneaky high prices. Just knowing their names takes away some of their power!”

vo.text: Then the Iron Banker claps his hands and grins a big grin. “Lunch is on me today — it makes me happy to see kids eat!”

vo.text: The whole class cheers as trays of food are passed down the table.

vo.text: “Now,” says the Iron Banker with a wink, “let's talk about saving your money — right after lunch!” When you know the name of a trap, it loses its power.
